_comment: Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` object into ~/.claude/settings.json or <project>/.claude/settings.json. Replace AGENT_ID with the id configured in the web UI and the host with your device IP or agent-observer.local. All hooks are command hooks running curl via bash (Git Bash on Windows); they are silent and always exit 0. The web UI generates this for you (Connect an agent). Hooks send only the event name, plus the tool name (tool/permission events) or the notification type (notifications), extracted locally from the hook JSON; the payload itself (prompts, tool input/output, paths, messages) is never sent.

hooks.command: v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=PreToolUse&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=PermissionRequest&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

v=$(grep -o '"notification_*[tT]ype" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=Notification&ntype=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
